name: Grunwald (Foederatus)
ac_note: Lorica Squamata or personal hide armor
notes: Germanic warrior auxiliary serving under personal combat charter. Bipennis (battleaxe), francisca throwing axes. Answers to the unit Optio.
gm_notes: NPC Foederatus. Not a legionary -- a Germanic auxiliary under foedus (personal charter). His loyalty is to the charter terms, not to Rome abstractly. In Sessions 2-3: his Germanic background gives the party a cultural bridge if used correctly. He resents being ordered around by people who cannot speak his language. Party members who learn a word or two of Germanic earn his respect disproportionately fast. He knows which Germanic forces around Vindolanda are warband and which are tribal civilians. This distinction matters in Session 3.
